narr: A stationary front draped over the region provided the focus for slow moving thunderstorm activity over northeastern Pennsylvania. Localized areas of 2 to 4 inches of rainfall contributed to some small stream and creek flooding near the Delaware River.
ev: The public reported water, rocks and gravel running across Twin Lakes Road near the Handsome Eddy Road intersection due to culvert being blown out by flood waters.
lsr: Water running across Twin Lakes road. Some gravel and rocks washed out of a culvert at Twin Lakes and Handsome Eddy Road intersection. Reported to NWS via social media.
